subject: Genetics
title: The Birth of DNA Fingerprinting
description: A quick win: understand The Birth of DNA Fingerprinting.

hook.text: In 1984, Alec Jeffreys stared at an X-ray film in his Leicester lab. He saw unique patterns. He saw the future.

buildup.text: Jeffreys discovered DNA regions that vary wildly between people. These 'minisatellites' formed unique barcodes.

discovery.text: He realized these patterns could identify individuals like fingerprints. DNA fingerprinting was born that day.

twist.text: His first forensic case freed an innocent suspect and caught the real killer. The technology proved itself instantly.

climax.text: Within years, every major police force adopted it. One lab accident changed criminal justice worldwide.

punchline.text: One scientist's eureka moment rewrote forensic history.
